definitions.meaning: Law-crafty, one skilled in law, a lawyer, scribe

quotations.english: to them the skilled in law answered

source_text: ǽ-cræftig; adj. Law-crafty, one skilled in law, a lawyer, scribe; legis peritus :-- Him ǽcræftig andswarode to them the skilled in law answered, Cd. 212; Th. 262, 10; Dan. 742.
